newsitem.title: UK: Medeva says keen to grow in Italy, Germany.
newsitem.headline: Medeva says keen to grow in Italy, Germany.

text.p: British drugs group Medeva Plc said on Wednesday that it was keen to build up its strength in Italy and Germany.
However in a telephone interview chief executive William Bogie declined to comment on whether the company was considering acquistions.
"We are still interested in Germany and Italy, those are two countries where in time I'd like to have a stronger presence," Bogie said.
Medeva, which has a strategy of growth through acquiring existing drugs businesses and adding new products, has greatly reinforced its position in the U.S. in the past year.
It has also added to its key presence in France, Spain and Switzerland.
